description: NAKSHATRA X is a Jaipur-based team at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, working on Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map. We're exploring how geospatial data, elevation models and interactive maps can support terrain-aware route planning on Mars. Our interests include software engineering, Python, GIS and data visualization. We welcome teammates skilled in GIS/remote sensing, web development, UI/UX, planetary science or storytelling. We value curiosity, collaboration and scientific accuracy.
